issue_request: FHIR-45872 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked for Request-pattern guidance explaining why fulfillment/execution status generally belongs in Task or event resources rather than in Request resources, and for follow-on change requests to point individual Request resources and Task to that guidance.
initial_application: Commit 1555ba4c2b1aa996160b4895a4bb9973d210e0b3 added the central fulfillment-status rationale to source/request/request-spreadsheet-notes.xml under a commit mentioning FHIR-45872. The current source retains the requested explanation in the Fulfillment/Execution section, and separate resource-specific follow-on issues and commits added links from individual Request resources and Task.
additional_context: FHIR Workflow minutes show the issue was created for proposed language on 2024-05-13 and accepted as Persuasive with Modification on 2024-06-17. Related applied issues FHIR-46331, FHIR-46333, FHIR-46336, FHIR-46339, FHIR-46341, FHIR-46342, FHIR-46343, and FHIR-46344 are separate resource-link tasks stemming from this seed. Exact-key Zulip search found no FHIR-45872 discussion that would alter the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current in-scope Request pattern already explains the separation between Request authorization status and fulfillment status, gives the requested rationale, and points implementers to Task or event resources for execution/fulfillment tracking.
